description: This file contains a SQLiteOpenHelper implementation that manages the creation and upgrade of a 'notes' database for a notes application. It defines schema details, SQL statements for table creation and indexing, and handles database version management.

classes.name: NotesDbHelper
classes.description: An internal class extending SQLiteOpenHelper that manages the notes database schema, creation, and upgrade routines.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and related indexes when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades. Currently drops and recreates the notes table.
